product_overview: A web client for a social reading platform that lets users discover books, manage a personal library (shelves, favorites, progress), browse readers and community activity, and authenticate to persist their state. The app supports a backend-backed or local/mock catalog with gradual migration of social features to persistent storage.
core_goals: Discover and explore books via curated home, explore, and search experiences.
Read detailed book information and reviews to decide what to read next.
Manage a personal library across three shelves (want-to-read, currently-reading, read) and persist favorites and progress.
Browse other readers and follow social activity to build a reading network.
Authenticate (register/login) to save library, favorites, and social state across sessions.

features.name: Book Catalog Discovery
features.description: Browse featured, trending and catalogued books from the Home and Explore pages and open books to see details.

Navigate to /explore -> See book grid with book cards
Navigate to /explore -> Scroll through book list
Navigate to /explore -> Click on a book card to view details

user_flows: Navigate to /explore -> Click on a book card to view details
Click on a book card to view details -> See book title, cover, author and description
Click on a book card to view details -> See book rating and genres
Click on a book card to view details -> See related books section
Click on a book card to view details -> See review section with existing reviews
Click on a book card to view details -> See options to add to library, set as favorite, and update progress

features.name: Add Book to Library
features.description: Place a book into one of the library shelves (want-to-read, currently-reading, read) from the book details or book card context and confirm it appears in the library.
user_flows: Navigate to /explore -> Click on a book card to view details
Click on a book card to view details -> Select a shelf option (want-to-read, currently-reading, read)
Select a shelf option (want-to-read, currently-reading, read) -> UI updates to show selected shelf
Select a shelf option (want-to-read, currently-reading, read) -> Navigate to /library
Navigate to /library -> Verify the book appears in the correct shelf

features.name: View User Library
features.description: See and navigate your personalized library with tabs for each shelf, sort the view, and see summary stats for reading activity.
user_flows: Navigate to /library -> See tabs for shelves (currently-reading, want-to-read, read)
Navigate to /library -> Click on a shelf tab to switch between shelves
Click on a shelf tab to switch between shelves -> See book cards in the selected shelf
See book cards in the selected shelf -> Sort by title, rating, or year
See book cards in the selected shelf -> See stats cards (currently reading, completed this year, etc.)

features.name: Mark Book as Favorite
features.description: Toggle a book's favorite status so users can mark books they love and see that status across their profile and library.
user_flows: Navigate to /explore -> Click on a book card to view details
Click on a book card to view details -> Toggle the favorite control to favorite the book
Toggle the favorite control to favorite the book -> See favorite state change in the UI
Toggle the favorite control to favorite the book -> Navigate to /profile
Navigate to /profile -> Verify favorite status is persisted and visible

features.name: Update Reading Progress
features.description: Record reading progress for books on the currently-reading shelf using a percentage input or slider and see progress reflected in the library.
user_flows: Navigate to /library -> Open a book in the currently-reading shelf to view details or controls
Open a book in the currently-reading shelf to view details or controls -> Use the progress input or slider to set a percentage between 0 and 100
Use the progress input or slider to set a percentage between 0 and 100 -> UI updates to show the new progress
Use the progress input or slider to set a percentage between 0 and 100 -> Navigate within /library
Navigate within /library -> Verify progress is displayed for the book in the shelf

features.name: User Authentication (Register & Login)
features.description: Create a new account and log in with email/password to persist library and social state across sessions.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill username and email -> Fill password meeting requirements -> Submit registration -> See success and be redirected to /
Navigate to /register -> Fill username and email -> Fill password that is too short -> Submit registration -> See validation error about password length
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See successful redirect to /

features.name: Browse Readers & Profiles
features.description: Discover other readers, open their public profiles and view public library sections and basic profile details.
user_flows: Navigate to /readers -> See a list of readers
Navigate to /readers -> Click a reader to open their profile
Click a reader to open their profile -> See reader profile information and public library sections
Click a reader to open their profile -> See lists of followers and following when available

features.name: Follow and Unfollow Users
features.description: Follow other readers to build a social graph; follow attempts create either a direct follow for public profiles or a pending follow request for private profiles.
user_flows: Navigate to /readers -> Click a reader to open their profile -> Initiate a follow action -> See follow state updated when the profile is public
Navigate to /readers -> Click a reader to open their profile -> Initiate a follow action -> See a pending follow request created when the profile is private
Initiate a follow action -> Initiate an unfollow action -> See the follow state revert and counts update

features.name: Community Feed
features.description: Consume community posts, reviews and activity; authenticated users can interact by liking or commenting on items in the feed.
user_flows: Navigate to /community -> See community feed with posts and reviews
Navigate to /community -> Scroll through the feed
Navigate to /community -> Interact with a post by liking it (authenticated) -> See like reflected in UI
Navigate to /community -> Interact with a post by adding a comment (authenticated) -> See comment displayed under the post
